releaseNotes:
• In-app direct installation: Tapping 'Install Update' now opens the Android system Package Installer directly instead of the sharing sheet
• Integrated REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES permission and native intent launcher
• Fix page squishing/clipping bug on Android APK when toggling single page and scroll modes
• Dedicated dual-container viewport with native block scrolling and flex-shrink protection
• High-performance persistent offscreen canvas caching
• New 'Go to Page' numeric jump & quick-chip navigation in PDF Score Viewer
• Accurate PDF page counts synced across library and Supabase
• Synced web and mobile releases with updated landing page
